correctness.rationale: Exact changes of coordinates reduce both equilibria to a rotation plus quadratic perturbation with opposite signed crossing. Exact symbolic integration gives I=π/240 and J=293π/5400 at the origin, I=−√2π/48 and J=793π/2700 at the lower focus. Polar return expansion proves the two nondegenerate Hopf radii and derivative signs; direct integration of dt/dθ with the quadratic radial correction gives the stated periods. The checker recomputes the critical integrals and a separate Poincaré simulation corroborates amplitudes and drift signs; finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The source naturally produces two disjoint branches of globally unique cycles; the physical-time period and local section displacement are natural observables needed to identify or calibrate the branches. Their strictly positive first-order period shifts despite opposite stability are not generic consequences of knowing the Hopf directions. The exact constants distinguish two nonconjugate oscillation clocks and allow parameter inference from near-onset periods. The scope is narrow and local, and no global period monotonicity is claimed.
